findings.summary: 'No hay nada que hacer pull' is ungrammatical. 'Nada que hacer' reads as 'nothing to do', with 'pull' left dangling. The shipped es construction is 'hacer pull de <x>' ('No se hizo pull de nada'), so the relative clause needs 'de lo que': 'nada de lo que hacer pull'. The meaning (nothing to pull; a no-op, not an error) and the {outcome} placement are unchanged.
